name: Titan, Mountain Lord

abilities.name: Mountain Crush
abilities.description: Deal 80 damage to target enemy. Stun adjacent enemies for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Immovable
abilities.description: All Earth units gain +20% Defense. Cannot be pushed or displaced.

lore: Ancient guardian of the mountain peaks, Titan's strength is as unyielding as the stone itself. Legends say he carved the first valleys with his bare hands.
